Improve a harness using contrastive probes.

1 propose(trace) → 2 run(probe) → 3 evaluate(candidate) → 4 select(edit) → 5 compose(next) → 6 rollback(failure)
Evidence: 6/41 repositories, 6/36 families; 6 trajectories (1 multi-checkpoint); exact audit: not sampled.
Variation: Contrastive probes, recursive improvement, and component-level editing.
Negative control: A one-shot prompt rewrite without probes is not E02.
